title: test: remove tempfile sink panic-family debt
body: Advances #575 with a bounded integration-test-only historical-baseline slice. This change converts the 71 `unwrap()` sites in `crates/uselesskey/tests/tempfile_sink.rs` into contextual `Result` propagation. Existing assertions and test cases remain intact; spawned-thread failures and parent-side `JoinHandle` panics are both propagated rather than hidden behind an additional panic channel. The branch gate accepts exactly two final files: - `crates/uselesskey/tests/tempfile_sink.rs` - `policy/no-panic-baseline.toml` The normal refusing baseline refresh must move the scanner from 3,422 to 3,351 findings, with 15 allowlisted, 3,336 baselined, zero new debt, zero stale baseline identities, zero expired entries, and no added or increased baseline identity. The focused integration suite, focused Clippy with `-D warnings`, semantic no-panic checker, formatting, and whitespace checks must pass on the exact final head before merge. No production behavior, public API, workflow, dependency, goal-state, or allowlist change is in scope. ---
